adrPass.classification: A: MCP namespace, v2 immutable Vault metadata, migration and native OAuth; B: existing Provider/Grant/transport/Evidence and stop/unknown semantics retained. ADR written before code, decision commit precedes source commit.

implemented: Helper v1 exact MCP hash/RFC4122-v4 namespace; native asynchronous bounded/cancellable Helper reads after grant
Desktop-only v1 safeStorage/plaintext migration, readback verification, same-directory metadata lock/CAS/atomic publication; unknown fields and original bytes preserved on precommit failure
v2 metadata-only file and immutable encrypted payload slots; all OAuth secrets including clientInformation/PKCE/discovery moved to Vault
bearer/header/env and valid OAuth token native transport injection, registry and credential revalidation before startup/call/next cognition, raw-token and wire-token redaction before Evidence

native mcp auth and mcp refresh via pinned official rmcp OAuth state machine; actual 401 metadata pointer, RFC8414 issuer discovery, PKCE/state/resource, preregistration/DCR, loopback callback, fresh immutable Vault generation
late Desktop OAuth callback generation CAS; native registry revision and metadata writer lock
Vault write capacity guard preserves previously readable ciphertext at existing 16 MiB limit
recoveryAndFailureCoverage: Helper unavailable/readback mismatch/later successful migration, second-item failure preserves whole old file
future/corrupt/duplicate/symlink/live-lock and concurrent-source rejection; failed rotation keeps current generation
Ask denial does not read Helper or start MCP; Helper SIGTERM cancel proves child reaped before any MCP startup
rotation during initialize blocks tools/call and next cognition, no uncertain dispatch manufactured
expired token and future/mismatched secret envelope fail before MCP startup
wrong state rejected then valid callback succeeds; wrong issuer causes no token exchange; cancellation closes listener and preserves bytes
native refresh success; invalid_grant, 302 token redirect and >1MiB response each send one token request, keep previous metadata and release lock
DCR stores client secret in Vault only; registry change while login pending blocks metadata publication
real native login then native authorized MCP call/Evidence, real production Desktop cold-reader verifies native token/refresh/expiry/client payload
preservedFailedAttempts: fixture script cwd and package resolution failures corrected using manifest-root absolute script path and package dist import
initial auth fixtures omitted required env/header binding fields; existing inventory assertions were retained
rotation blocked tool but initially allowed next cognition; fixed actual credential revision binding, original exit/effect assertions retained
OAuth refresh with empty redirect failed config; corrected existing-default handling
fixture closed stdout after pending URL, producing Broken pipe on final receipt; fixture now owns/drains reader through child exit
DCR fixture lacked required redirect_uris; fixed fixture from actual pinned SDK type, retained real DCR assertion

first broad interop gate caught a fixture emitting the synthetic credential even when not injected; fixture now echoes the actual configured/request token; global secret assertions retained and expanded
clippy collapsible-if failure corrected; no lint suppression
limits: No personal credentials, user task data, OS keychain secrets or running apps were used/changed by validation. Helper ping only for real OS binary; Vault cryptography verified with injected in-memory key protector.

Local platform macOS arm64 only; Windows/Linux keystore, stable signing, installed upgrade/downgrade, physical IME/readscreen and real provider/IdP remain unverified. Implementer self-review is not independent.
Runtime consumes valid OAuth tokens; expired/unknown relative expiry requires explicit mcp refresh/auth. Automatic refresh/continuation bound to original grant remains open.
Only IPv4 loopback callback, bounded same-origin OAuth discovery/DCR redirects, no token redirects/retries; configured proxy/custom certificate and full MCP protocol recovery parity remain open.

Retired/orphan encrypted Vault slots retained. No automatic GC; capacity full fails before replacing old Vault. Historical already-oversized Vault requires controlled offline preservation/recovery, not automatic truncation.
Default peer remains old migration-period entry; no Bun/Node engine sidecar in peer-native. External user-configured capability processes are separate per ADR129.

P4 total also retains full model auth/private wire/settings, Source catalog/Host discovery, remaining Runtime tools, Skill/Plugin/Hook, headless/ACP/command parity; P5 cannot be marked started until the accepted P4 total gate is met.
